112.subject: Application: Account Manager, Customer Business Development – Alex Rivera
112.body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am a final-year Finance student at Bangkok Metropolitan University, graduating in May 2027 and available full-time from June 2027, and I am applying for the Account Manager, Customer Business Development role.

At Campus Co, a student-run company, I negotiated and won MetroMart as a modern-trade retail partner and helped develop an SME shelf for local suppliers, now in 100 MetroMart branches. In the same student-run company I built a 30-session sales training program for 383 reps (120 certified) and delivered 6 sessions personally.

The role's focus on growing business with retail customers is the work I want to build a career in. My CV is attached, and I would welcome a conversation.

Best regards,
Alex Rivera
081-555-0199
alex.rivera@example.com
linkedin.com/in/alex-rivera-demo
